FIELDS.NAME: Sew & Stitch Fabric Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sew & Stitch Fabric Store, we specialize in providing a wide range of fabrics, sewing supplies, and related notions, catering to both hobbyists and professional seamstresses. Our core operations focus on retail sales, complemented by offering sewing classes and workshops to engage the community and foster customer loyalty. We prioritize safety and compliance by maintaining a clean and organized store environment, implementing comprehensive safety measures, and ensuring that all subcontractors, including class instructors, carry their own insurance. Our dedicated team is trained in safety protocols to effectively manage risk and prevent accidents. With a strong emphasis on customer service and quality products, we strive to be the go-to destination for all fabric and sewing needs in Sewingtown.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a water pipe burst in the storage area, causing damage to fabric inventory and shelving. The estimated loss amount was $2,500. The claim has been settled and closed. On 07/23/2022, we experienced theft of merchandise valued at $1,000, which has been reported to the authorities and is currently under investigation.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sunday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, Secure Safe for cash and valuable inventory storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and a secured safe for cash and valuable inventory storage.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations primarily focus on retail fabric and sewing supplies, with a commitment to safety and compliance.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store does not sponsor any athletic teams. Our focus is primarily on retail fabric and sewing supplies, along with offering sewing classes and workshops.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The management team at Sew & Stitch Fabric Store is responsible for checking and verifying these certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a strong focus on compliance and ethical business practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years for Sew & Stitch Fabric Store.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our team is comprised solely of our own staff members, ensuring consistent training and adherence to our safety protocols.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store carries workers' compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect both the business and its employees. This coverage is critical for addressing any potential workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store also operates Sew & Stitch Quilting Studio.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The only active policy noted is SST-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations primarily focus on retailing fabric and sewing supplies, along with offering sewing classes and workshops.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our primary focus is on retail sales of fabric and sewing supplies. We prioritize safety and compliance in our operations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, indicating a stable financial history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on retailing fabric and sewing supplies with a strong emphasis on safety and compliance.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations primarily focus on retail sales of fabric and sewing supplies, with no involvement in high-risk activities. We maintain proper safety protocols and measures to manage risks effectively.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our focus on compliance and safety ensures that we maintain a positive operational environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Sew & Stitch Fabric Store currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains comprehensive fire safety measures to ensure compliance and safety.

reviews: Sew & Stitch Fabric Store has an amazing selection of fabrics! The staff is always helpful and knowledgeable.
I love taking sewing classes here! The instructors are patient and the atmosphere is very welcoming.
Great place for all your sewing needs! They have everything from fabric to tools, and the prices are reasonable.
The store is well-organized and easy to navigate. I always find what I'm looking for and more!
I appreciate the community events they host. It's a fantastic way to meet fellow sewing enthusiasts!
